anyone landing here from a cloud server: I hit the same thing (AWS/GCP IPs blocked). In my tests, datacenter proxies worked about 2% of the time and residential proxies about 100%, so residential proxies are the way to go if you self-host.

One more gotcha if this is for RAG: watch which caption track you pick. In a 50-video test, about 1 in 4 transcripts came back in the wrong language when taking the first track in the list (English videos returning Arabic or Albanian captions). I wrote up the details and a fix here:
https://dev.to/massarico182/why-your-youtube-transcript-scraper-returns-the-wrong-language-and-how-to-fix-it-8fj
